# cancho

> A native systems language in which resource ownership and authority are part of the type, and the ecosystem built with it.

Status: pre-1.0. Alpha products are built with it; the compiler is the Rust one, and a second compiler written in cancho is being checked against it (it does not yet refuse everything the language refuses). See the roadmap for what is open.

Source: https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho
Docs: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho/
Roadmap: https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho/ROADMAP.html
Writing cancho programs (agents): https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho/blob/main/AGENTS.md
This site as Markdown: https://cancho.dev/agents.md
Everything in one file: https://cancho.dev/llms-full.txt
The ecosystem as JSON: https://cancho.dev/data/ecosystem.json

## Ecosystem

- [cancho-ui](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-ui) (built): A UI language whose compiler knows what each component is allowed to do. Builds JavaScript and DOM.
- [cancho-hooks](https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-hooks/) (alpha): Webhook delivery: on disk before the 202, signed, retried, dead-lettered and replayable.
- [cancho-cache](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-cache) (alpha): Redis-compatible string cache over RESP2/RESP3, expiry and LRU in a fixed arena.
- [cancho-gateway](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-gateway) (design): An auditable HTTP/1.1 reverse proxy: a fixed upstream set proven by the authority report.
- [cancho-mqtt](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-mqtt) (design): An MQTT 3.1.1 broker: one thread, one poller, bounded memory.
- [cancho-dns](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-dns) (design): A forwarding and caching DNS resolver: bounded parser, fixed arena.
- [cancho-oci](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-oci) (design): Container images without a daemon: a deterministic OCI image builder and registry client.
- [cancho-pg](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-pg) (early): PostgreSQL client: v3 protocol, SCRAM-SHA-256, extended queries, TLS, non-blocking pool.
- [cancho-schema](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-schema) (early): Schemas as data: validation, problem+json errors and JSON Schema 2020-12 from one value.
- [cancho-web](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-web) (early): Typed routes, validated bodies, problem+json errors and an OpenAPI document from one declaration.
- [cancho-log](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-log) (early): A durable, segmented, append-only log with crash-safe recovery that cuts off a torn tail.
- [cancho-stats](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-stats) (design): Statistics on tabular data as a command line an agent can read: exact sums, tests, intervals, resampling.
- [cancho-ml](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-ml) (design): Classical ML, pipelines and evaluation: deterministic, bounded, agent-first.
- [cancho-tools](https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-tools/) (working): Nine small tools for agents: seek, list, peek, jsonq, tally, hash, write, replace, move. JSON out, errors that name a rule.
- [cancho-table](https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-table/) (built): Select, filter, group and aggregate CSV/TSV for agents; bounded, exact, byte-stable.
- [cancho-robot](https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-robot/) (design): A robot arm controller: the Feetech servo bus, SO-101 kinematics and a safety core every motion goes through.
- [cancho-gpu](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-gpu) (built): A compiler for lex-gpu's .lx tile kernels to CUDA C and Metal, written in cancho.
